subject: Moving Notice Sequenza User Group to matrix.org

messages.author: dad6980b76d10753
messages.subject: Moving Notice Sequenza User Group to matrix.org
parts:
Dear all,

this Google Group has long served its purpose. Google Groups isn’t a very engaging or popular platform anymore, and despite several attempts to stop it, the group has been overrun by spammers for the last 5+ years.

This is unacceptable, and it buries whatever useful information is left here.

So I’ve made the drastic decision to block all new posts in this group from now on, and move conversations about Sequenza to a Matrix channel. Matrix is an open standard for decentralized communication. You can join here:

https://matrix.to/#/#sequenza:matrix.org

I’m also active on Mastodon (https://genomic.social/@frafav), and I’ll try to answer any post tagged #sequenza or #sequenzahelp.

Hope to see you there :)


Thanks for the many helpful and constructive conversations over the years,
Francesco
